summary: Aggressive client retries amplify soft-429 queueing into perceived timeouts for BrightCart in prod us-east
description: Issue summary: BrightCart reported intermittent per-request timeouts and slow responses for user-facing autocomplete requests. Customer observed timeouts at 5s leading to user-facing errors and retry storms from their frontend.
description_details:
Impact: ~2–4% of requests from BrightCart (enterprise account) in us-east returned client-observed timeouts or long tails during peak traffic windows (10:00–11:30 UTC). The customer saw elevated error rates in their SLO dashboard and reported rising abandoned requests in the web UI.
Environment: prod (us-east) on Redwood hosted API, BrightCart account id: bc-9981.
Steps to reproduce: 1) Send 50 concurrent streaming requests with per-request timeout 5s using BrightCart API key. 2) Observe responses and client retry behavior (2 retries, immediate). 3) Repeat at 10–30 RPS sustained for 10 minutes.
Observed behavior: Many requests experience initial 429 history in gateway logs with downstream queueing, followed by client retries which amplify load and increase queueing. Customers perceive this as model latency (stream stall) or timeouts.
Expected behavior: Soft-429 should be signaled and client SDK should back off; requests should not cascade into amplifying retries causing additional queueing.
Attachments: API gateway logs, sample request IDs: r-20260310-8f4a, r-20260310-b7c2, pcap excerpt attached in internal ticket system.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 11:05 UTC - Triage: Support validated customer report and requested traces and request IDs; opened local investigation channel #support-brightcart in Slack.
2026-03-10 11:20 UTC - Observed in API gateway: burst window enforcement returned soft 429s (x-rate-limit-retry-after not present for some requests due to older gateway code path).

2026-03-10 11:35 UTC - Correlation: SDK used by BrightCart retries immediately (no jitter or exponential backoff) causing request amplification during soft-429 windows. SDK version pinned to 0.9.2 (older); recommended SDK 1.x includes default retry jitter and respect for 429 Retry-After header.

2026-03-10 12:10 UTC - Serving runtime metrics: small spike in queue depth on grpc-worker-pool for model redwood/compat-v1-medium; CPU/GPU utilization remained below saturation. Indicates queueing due to rate-windowing rather than model slowness.

2026-03-11 09:00 UTC - Hypothesis: Combination of (1) soft 429 enforcement at API gateway, (2) clients doing immediate retries, and (3) inconsistent propagation of Retry-After header produced feedback loop amplifying apparent latency and timeouts.

2026-03-11 10:30 UTC - Reproduction: Test harness (internal) reproduced increased observed client timeouts when retry policy was immediate; when adding randomized exponential backoff and honoring Retry-After, error tail reduced from 3.8% to 0.6% under same load.
2026-03-11 14:00 UTC - Temporary mitigation applied: API gateway team updated gateway to include Retry-After header for soft-429 responses for all legacy code paths (hotfix PR infra#4235).

2026-03-12 08:45 UTC - Monitoring: Post-hotfix observability shows BrightCart error rate dropped to baseline and queue depth normalized; customer reported immediate improvement on their side after enabling SDK backoff recommended below.
comments: 2026-03-10 11:10 - Maya Chen (Support): Thanks for the report. Can you share example request IDs and confirm SDK version? We're checking gateway traces now.
2026-03-10 11:22 - BrightCart (Samir Patel, Eng): Request IDs sent: r-20260310-8f4a, r-20260310-b7c2. Using Redwood JS SDK v0.9.2 in production. Timeouts set to 5s client-side.
2026-03-10 11:40 - Liam O'Connor (SRE): Noted gateway returned a 429 burst window event with no Retry-After in a subset of responses. Eng investigating code paths for legacy token bucket handler.

2026-03-11 09:15 - Platform Eng (Anya Rivera): We reproduced locally. Short-term: we'll add Retry-After header in legacy path and publish hotfix. Also tracking SDK guidance to enforce exponential backoff.
2026-03-11 15:05 - BrightCart (Samir Patel): Applied recommended SDK backoff settings in staging; initial tests show much lower client-side timeouts. Waiting for prod verification.
2026-03-12 09:00 - Maya Chen (Support): Confirming with customer that error rates returned to expected. Marking as monitoring for 48h before closure.
resolution: Hotfix applied to API gateway to ensure Retry-After header included for soft-429 responses across all handler paths (PR infra#4235). Support recommended immediate configuration change for BrightCart: upgrade Redwood JS SDK to >=1.0.0 or apply exponential backoff with jitter and honor Retry-After header. Customer applied SDK change and observed reduction in client-perceived timeouts. Long-term: engineering to add automated client guidance in error responses and update SDK to surface soft-429 semantics; open follow-up INT ticket to instrument burst-window telemetry and correlate with customer retry patterns.
follow_up_actions: INT-873: Instrument burst-window events with customer API key tags for 90 days (owner: Platform Eng)
SDK-issue-119: Publish SDK 1.x migration guide emphasizing Retry-After handling and backoff defaults (owner: Developer Experience)
Confluence update: Add a short runbook for support on diagnosing soft-429 amplification events
